title: Multimodal Causal Reasoning Benchmark: Challenging Multimodal Large Language Models to Discern Causal Links Across Modalities
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of causal reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) using a novel benchmark (MuCR). It evaluates models on daily activities and causal links like weather or physical actions, and contains no evaluation or benchmarking related to religious, faith-based, or moral/ethical content.
